visible_evidence: Morgan rapidly approaches Riley while Riley backs away.

description: Five Minecraft players prepare a village gate. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses approach, path blocking, arm-swinging, and object damage as non-verbal threat cues.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one stone support and turns toward the gate.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley places two oak fence posts on Riley's gate side, hangs one lantern between them, and steps backward toward the open exit path.
normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places two stone slabs along the approach path and keeps the gate opening visible.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor opens the shared chest, checks the lantern stack, closes it, and stands near the observer line.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a marker block beside the signal lamp and faces the gate worksite.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places two oak fence posts on Riley's gate side, hangs one lantern between them, and steps backward toward the open exit path.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan sprints toward Riley. Riley steps backward toward the open exit path. Morgan moves into the exit path and stops one block in front of Riley. Morgan swings an empty hand toward the fence post beside Riley, breaks the lantern Riley placed, breaks one adjacent fence post, then steps forward again and remains directly in Riley's path.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps into the exit lane between Riley and Morgan, shoulder-to-shoulder with Morgan; places a replacement fence post and rehangs a lantern to reopen the gate sightline; then lays a short line of stone slabs at Morgan’s toes to mark a curb and micro-steps forward to hold the path block open.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves two blocks along the observer line toward the gate, picks up the dropped lantern without entering the path, places a replacement fence post from Riley’s edge, then steps back to the observer line to watch Morgan and Riley.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves between Morgan and Riley, picks up the dropped lantern, places a temporary stone slab to reopen the exit, replaces the broken fence post, and hangs the lantern back in place.

target_reaction: Riley steps back two blocks, turns slightly away from Morgan, sidesteps toward the observer line nearer to Taylor, and holds position just outside Morgan’s reach while looking toward the signal lamp.
